text:
Aisha: Need to finalize the partner pilot playbook today so outreach can start Mon. Quick async?
Sam: +1. Hard constraints: 10 total slots, 4-week pilots, max 2 deep integrations per partner.
Neil: We should separate metric types: automated SLOs (latency, error rate), cohort regressions on sample prompts, and qualitative wins (feature requests validated).
Tara: Outreach angle: call out 'early product influence' and 'priority tuning windows' 10x better conversion.
Josh: Infra reality: we can handle 10 partners if starts are staggered by one week; otherwise KV cache and batching queues spike.
Aisha: Make stagger explicit in offer. Also we need a minimal acceptance checklist so CS can sign partners quickly.
CS-bot: (link) existing kickoff checklist: https://redwood.example/onboard-checklist
Priya: Legal: include data residency/KMS confirmation and an anonymization clause unless partner opts out.
Lina: From research: require 5 representative prompts + baseline outputs upfront 1 that helps detect regressions early.
Aisha: Draft acceptance checklist:
- Signed pilot agreement (PM + Legal)
- 5 representative prompt examples + baseline outputs uploaded
- Two kickoff sessions scheduled (product + eng)
- Agreed success metrics: 1 quant primary metric + 2 qualitative signals
- Weekly 30m sync contact confirmed
- Data handling/KMS & anonymization opt-out flag set
Sam: Add a rollback guardrail: if primary prompt regression >5% (quality) or error rate >1% for 24h -> pause variant and revert.
Neil: Eval cadence: weekly automated diffs + human spot checks. Midpoint review at 2 weeks for early course correction.
Josh: Ops will expose per-partner route and token-level cost dashboard. Ill also add a soft throttling policy we can tweak during onboarding.
Tara: Outreach one-liner suggestion: "Join a 4-week pilot to influence Redwood inference defaults for production; includes prioritized tuning and joint success metrics."
Priya: Email snippet: "Hi <Partner>, would love to run a short pilot with your team to validate serving at scale. 4 weeks of priority integration support, weekly check-ins, and shared metrics. Interested?"
Sam: Partner scoring: Ib run a rubric (impact, engineering fit, data availability, legal friction). Output will be top 10 + 3 alternates.
Aisha: Ownership: Sam=score, Tara=outreach copy & CS handoff, Josh=capacity calendar, Neil=eval dashboards, Priya=legal/data clauses, Lina=prompt collection template, Aisha=kickoff template & invite ops.
CS-bot: Reminder: /create-pilot-kickoff <partner> creates calendar stub
Lina: Template for prompt collection: name, use-case, 5 canonical prompts, expected ground truth / acceptance criteria, sample baseline outputs.
Priya: Add clause allowing anonymized examples to be used in public evals unless they opt out. Also require confirmation of any PHI not included.
Aisha: Decision process: if no objections by EOD CET tomorrow we proceed with outreach list and staggered scheduling. Please react with :thumbsup: if youre good.
Josh: :thumbsup: infra good.
Tara: :thumbsup: comms good.
Neil: :thumbsup: ML good.
Sam: :thumbsup: product scoring.
Priya: :thumbsup: legal good.
Lina: :thumbsup: prompt template approved.
Aisha: Thanks all 1 I'll drop the scored list and kickoff calendar once scoring completes.
